# ractermx_domain_tag (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX domain tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a domain tag for organizing domains.
resource "ractermx_domain_tag" "production" {
  name  = "production"
  color = "#22c55e"
}

# Create a tag with the default color.
resource "ractermx_domain_tag" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tag (max 50 chars).

### Optional

- `color` (String) The hex color of the tag (e.g., #3b82f6).

### Read-Only

- `domains_count` (Number) The number of domains assigned to this tag.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a domain tag using its numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_domain_tag.production 42
```
